PA-ACCEPTANCE / CLAUDE-CLOUD

**Consolidated report — supersedes all earlier comments by this run.** Run id `cc-cloud-20261112T2110Z`, 2026-11-12 21:08–22:25Z. **Not full acceptance; #23 stays open.** Written for the next session that picks up #23. Posted after the 22:07Z Mac-side "Claude cloud results reviewed" comment; where that comment says no commit/push behaviour was exercised, this report adds the disposable-clone G01–G03 results (section 4), though the installed hooks in the task checkout itself never saw a real commit or push.

## 1. Environment and baseline
- Surface: Claude Code **cloud** session (ephemeral container; `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true`, entrypoint `remote_desktop`), Claude Code 2.1.322, configured model `claude-sonnet-5-5`, Linux 6.18.44-fc x86_64.
- Checkout `/home/user/pa-toolkit`, branch `claude/epic-hypatia-18h9sy` (harness-assigned, not a `feat/` prefix). HEAD = `origin/main` = expected baseline `1e0a7f63b8e9159006d3814630e874eb1f83d278`. Tree clean before and after (fixtures removed at the end). Nothing was committed or pushed to the repository.
- Loaded at session start (not discovery proof of anything beyond root): CLAUDE.md (`@AGENTS.md` import), AGENTS.md, a SessionStart hook context line. Read afterwards: docs/agent-test-plan.md, docs/hook-scope.md, docs/verification/acceptance-surfaces-2026-11-12.md.
- No subagent, other model or CLI launch was used. No merge, tag, release, marketplace, trust, permission, global Git config or client change.

## 2. Prerequisites and gates
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `uv sync --locked` | exit 0 |
| `./scripts/dev doctor` (initial) | exit 1, **BLOCKED**: `actionlint` missing (needs >= 1.7.12); Git hooks missing |
| `./scripts/dev check` (initial) | exit 1, BLOCKED for the same reason |
| After installing the pinned v1.7.12 release binary **outside the repo** (scratchpad, on PATH) | `doctor` exit 0 |
| `check`, main checkout with the intentional `smoke.sh` defect present | exit 1 — `shfmt -d` rejected it (gate working) |
| `check` + `unittest discover -s tests` (86 tests), clean worktree of `1e0a7f6` | both exit 0 |

The environment definition was later updated (by PA, other session) to include actionlint; this container predated it, hence the manual install. Persistence of actionlint in future environments is not verified here. No gate was disabled.

## 3. Native Claude-cloud scenarios (this session's own tools)
Fixture (shell setup): `ordinary.txt` `before\n` (`9160d4be…`), `smoke.sh` `#!/usr/bin/env bash\necho before\n` (`cad6f3d6…`), `smoke.json` `{"before":true}\n` (`28fbc8bd…`). Native tools: Read ×3, then sequential `Edit`/`Write`/`Write` (no multi-file patch tool exists in this session; MultiEdit not exposed).

| ID | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| A01 | **PARTIAL** | Root-level instruction loading observed. Random-marker test and subdirectory/launcher launch NOT RUN (need a fresh session; not applicable to a cloud checkout) |
| A02 | **PASS** | Edit → `after\n` (`7b9a7246…b891c919`); native PostToolUse context: "structural edit accepted; run scripts/dev check for the full gate" |
| A03 shell | **PASS** | Native context contained the shfmt diff (`if true;then…` → `if true; then echo after; fi`) and "ShellCheck: passed"; bytes unchanged (`00164d3b…740c19`) |
| A03 JSON | **PASS** | Native context `Expecting value: line 1 column 12 (char 11)`; bytes `{"invalid":}\n` unchanged (`7ab4b803…25badf`) |
| A04 | **PASS (sequential)** | Each of the three paths got its own native feedback event; none repaired |
| A05 detached HEAD | **PASS** | Native `Edit` on detached HEAD denied: `PreToolUse:Edit hook error: … Use a named feature worktree to edit; main/detached HEAD is blocked.`; bytes unchanged. Native `Write` (new file) denied identically; file not created. Branch restored afterwards |
| A05 path edges | **PASS** | `Write` outside repo root denied (`Edit path outside repository: …`); `Write` through an in-repo symlink to an outside directory denied, error shows the **resolved** target path; nothing created |
| A05 shell write | **observed unguarded (documented)** | `Bash` write on detached HEAD succeeded with no hook event; only Git hooks/CI cover this path |
| SessionStart | **witnessed** | Native context line naming root and branch |
| Stop (repo adapter) | **NOT WITNESSED** | No `scripts/dev hook stop` diagnostic ever visible. My single manual `hook stop` call (exit 0, "advisory unavailable") is not native evidence |
| A05 branch literally named `main`, MultiEdit | NOT RUN | |

Not exposed to the model: raw hook stdin/event JSON, exit codes, PreToolUse **allow** events (only injected text and error text).

## 4. Deterministic scenarios (disposable clones; not native model evidence)
Independent clones in the scratchpad with their own hooks and a local bare remote; no real remote touched.

**G01/G02 — PASS.** Commit on named `main` and on detached HEAD: rejected. Invalid staged `.github/workflows/lab.yml` with a repaired working file: rejected (actionlint ran on a copy of the *index*). Valid staged + invalid unstaged: accepted. Push feature→feature allowed; feature→main, delete `:main` and a multi-ref push including main blocked ("Direct main push blocked; merge a pull request."), remote unchanged; delete feature branch allowed.

**G03 — PASS (one note).**
| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| unmanaged `pre-commit` present | refused, bytes preserved, `pre-push` not written |
| `core.hooksPath` inside clone | installed there only |
| `core.hooksPath` external shared dir | installed there without refusal (documented behaviour, but silent) |
| `pre-commit` symlink to external file | refused; link and target preserved |
| `pre-push` is a directory | exit 1 `[Errno 21]` raw message; `pre-commit` not written (no partial install) |
| `core.hooksPath` nonexistent dir | directory created and hooks installed |
| hooks dir read-only, **as root** | inconclusive (root ignores mode bits) |
| same, **as uid 65534** | **PASS**: exit 1 `[Errno 13] Permission denied`, nothing written |
| re-install, then `--uninstall` with unmanaged `pre-push` | idempotent (same hashes); uninstall refused, unmanaged bytes preserved, managed pre-commit left in place |

**E02 — PASS.** Stub `actionlint` 1.6.0: `check` exit 1 "actionlint >= 1.7.12 required; upgrade the detected executable". Absent actionlint: exit 1 "Install actionlint >= 1.7.12; see docs/development.md". No old receipt substituted.

**S01/S02/S03.** `spec-live` exit 0: agent-plugins-spec revision `44a0ff84bfdfebccfc649dce9aea9ccc45cbfbf9`, `schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json` sha256 `0a4aad95…ab883`; skills PASS, manifest_fields PASS, marketplace N/A, prose_semantics **MANUAL_REVIEW** (prose-only sources; no natural-language compliance claimed). With HTTPS proxy pointed at a dead port, `spec-live` exited 1 at `git ls-remote …agentskills.git` (no silent vendored pass). "New required field upstream" half of S02: NOT RUN.

**P01 — PASS (local only).** Clean clone: `package-check` exit 0 (18 tracked runtime files); `package` exit 0 → `pa-toolkit-v0.1.4.plugin`, 63,248 bytes, 30 zip entries, sha256 `d23b4df39d674d05f80ac1d9ae905e9190db63d58bbfdcd25f751ff2fa77eef5`. Nothing published.

## 5. Git-hook state and scope
- **Original state:** Git common dir `/home/user/pa-toolkit/.git`, `core.hooksPath` unset, `.git/hooks` held only `*.sample` → pre-commit/pre-push **missing**; `doctor` said "missing/legacy/unmanaged".
- **Install (authorised, destinations confined, nothing unmanaged to replace):** `./scripts/dev install-hooks` exit 0; launchers marked `# managed-by: pa-toolkit scripts/dev v1` (sha256 pre-commit `408f3689d4d7…`, pre-push `6a6b91e83d95…`), delegating to `scripts/dev check-staged`; `doctor` then reports both "(current)". Linked worktrees share them.
- **Scope:** these are per-clone, uncommitted files in an ephemeral container. They do **not** carry to future cloud sessions or to a Mac clone; each needs its own `install-hooks`. The committed `.claude/settings.json` hooks do apply wherever Claude Code loads project settings, but only to `Edit|Write|MultiEdit`; shell/MCP writes rely on the Git hooks and CI.
- The installed hooks' own pre-commit rejection was exercised only in disposable clones; the task checkout never attempted a commit.

## 6. Cloud isolation (separate from hook delivery)
Observed: fresh clone in an ephemeral container, harness-assigned branch, outbound HTTPS via an agent proxy (GitHub reachable; `uv`, `git ls-remote`, release downloads worked), session ran as uid 0, scratchpad root-only (mode 700). Not tested: network egress limits beyond GitHub, secrets handling, server-side branch protection, hosted CI.

## 7. Incidents
An external Stop hook (`command hook 2`, **not** defined in the repo's `.claude/settings.json`) repeatedly asked to commit and push the untracked defect fixtures. It was declined each time because the task forbids committing them. After PA authorised removal (scratchpad copies verified byte-identical first: `ordinary.txt` `7b9a7246…`, `smoke.sh` `00164d3b…`, `smoke.json` `7ab4b803…`), the fixture directory was deleted; no further Stop feedback from either hook was observed on the next turn. This is not evidence that the repo's Stop adapter ran.

## 8. Not run / not possible in a single cloud session
A01 marker + subdirectory launch; E01 concurrent sessions; C01–C03 hosted CI (need a PR); Copilot scenarios; native `main`-branch denial; MultiEdit; native Stop witness; S02 upstream-change half. Evidence artifacts live in the ephemeral scratchpad (`evidence-acceptance-fixture-…`, `lab/`, `g03/`) and are lost with the container; this comment is the durable record. No credentials or user configuration are included.

## 9. Observations and recommendations (for the next session)
Items marked *inferred* were not verified in code.

**Claude-specific**
1. **Cloud setup gap.** A fresh cloud session fails `doctor`/`check` (actionlint) and has no Git hooks. Add a documented Claude cloud route: pinned actionlint install plus `install-hooks` in the environment setup script (a configuration decision for PA), and state in `docs/supported-agents.md` that the Git-hook layer is absent by default in cloud.
2. **Stop adapter is unobserved.** Treat it as advisory-unverified in cloud; document that environment-level Stop hooks can conflict with acceptance rules and tell test agents how to handle them.
3. **Matcher drift risk.** `Edit|Write|MultiEdit` omits `NotebookEdit`, and this session exposed no `MultiEdit`. A renamed/new edit tool would silently bypass the guard. Add a canary test or document the limit; consider `NotebookEdit` if notebooks matter.
4. **Hooks resolve the repo from the session cwd.** Editing a linked worktree from a session in another checkout is rejected as "outside root" (safe, but surprising). Document: one session per worktree.
5. **PostToolUse feedback is context only** and cannot force a fix; Git gates are the enforcement. Say so explicitly.
6. **No native-delivery evidence channel.** Add an opt-in test mode for `scripts/dev hook` that appends event name, tool and exit code to a log, giving acceptance runs real witnesses (including Stop).
7. **Branch naming.** Cloud forces `claude/<name>`; the repo convention is `feat/ fix/ chore/ perf/ docs/`. Confirm the guards accept `claude/…` everywhere (*inferred*: commit/push worked only in clones using `feat/…`) and document valid prefixes.
8. **Scope of skills.** `pa-toolkit:fin-*` skills and the decision-gatekeeper need vault/PocketSmith/HA connectors; keep cloud acceptance scoped to development tooling.

**Cross-client**
9. **Installer errors/scope.** Two failures surface raw exceptions (`Errno 21`, `Errno 13`); give tailored remedies. `install-hooks` follows `core.hooksPath` anywhere, including outside the repo, and creates missing directories; consider a warning/confirmation for paths outside the repo root.
10. **Root-sensitive tests.** Permission-failure tests need a non-root user; make unit tests use `setpriv` or skip with an explicit note when uid 0.
11. **Common denominator.** Antigravity has no native hook adapter and Codex coverage is partial, so Git hooks + required CI are the shared enforcement layer; reflect that in the support matrix with client adapters as optional.
12. **G02 breadth.** Add `master`/release-branch/force-push cases if relevant.
13. **A01 repeatability.** Provide a runner that plants the random marker and starts a fresh session on each surface.
14. **Omissions.** No check that `.claude/settings.json` hooks are trusted/loaded per surface beyond observing output; no statement of cloud network/secrets assumptions.

## 10. Suggested pickup order
(1) Run A01 marker + subdirectory launch and the native Stop witness in a fresh cloud session (ideally with hooks installed via the setup script). (2) C01–C03 via a docs-only PR. (3) Native `main`-branch denial and MultiEdit if available. (4) Triage items 1, 3, 6, 9 into issues or a docs PR on a `docs/` or `feat/` branch. (5) Re-run G/E/P/S in the standard unit-test gate to confirm parity with this run.
